_notes: Bu dosya Lissom'un ölçülebilir büyüklüklerinin TEK kaynağıdır.
Native (Kotlin/Swift) motor AYNI dosyayı okur ve AYNI sayıyı üretmek zorundadır (G4 differential test).
L-009: acı metriklerinde 'plane' zorunludur — ham 3D acı ROM uclarinda ±5.7° sistematik hata verir.
confidenceClass: A/B/C — G1 kapı protokolü §1'deki eklem güven sınıfı; MAE eşiği buna göre uygulanır.

M-F-34 taban-değeri kuralı: tolerans taşıyan oran metrikleri kusursuz-durum `baseline` değerini beyan eder; tolerans TABAN-göreli yorumlanır. Tabanı sıfır sanmak sessiz hata üretir — L-072 tam olarak buydu: `shoulder_line_foreshortening` tabanı 0,80 iken guard `> 0.15` yazılmış, her duruşta tetiklenmişti. Değerler sentetik nötr duruşta ÖLÇÜLDÜ, tahmin edilmedi; kapı A11 beyanı doğruluyor.

metrics.description: Shoulder flexion: angle between torso line and upper arm, sagittal plane. 0 = arm at side, 180 = fully overhead.
Elbow angle. Used as an invalidation guard: a bent elbow inflates overhead reach.
Hip angle between torso and thigh, sagittal plane. Smaller = deeper flexion.
Knee angle between thigh and shank, sagittal plane. 180 = straight leg.
Forward trunk inclination from vertical, sagittal plane. 0 = upright. Uses the derived mid-line (L-010).

Sideways trunk inclination from vertical, frontal plane. MUST use the derived mid-line: a one-sided hip-to-shoulder vector carries a spurious lateral component (shoulder width != hip width) worth up to 11 deg (L-010).
Shank angle from vertical during knee-to-wall. Proxy for ankle dorsiflexion range. Class C: ankle is the least reliable joint on a single 2D camera.

How far the heel sits above the toe line, normalised by torso length. Invalidation guard for heel lift during squat. NOTE: the first definition used heel-to-toe DISTANCE, which measures foot length and stays constant no matter what the heel does — the gate caught it as a dead metric (L-028).
Fingertip-to-ankle distance normalised by torso length. Body-size independent forward reach measure.

Vertical knee-above-ankle gap, normalised by torso length. Proxy for how far the trailing knee descends in a lunge. NOT a knee-to-floor distance: pose gives no ground plane, so this is measured against the body's own reference.

Perpendicular distance of the hip mid-point from the shoulder-to-ankle line, normalised by torso length. 0 = straight body line; grows as the hips sag or pike. Sagittal plane so that sagging is not confused with lateral drift.

Frontal-plane projected shoulder width, normalised by torso length. Shrinks as the torso rotates away from the camera — an INDIRECT proxy for transverse rotation, not a rotation angle. WARNING: transverse-plane rotation is not reliably recoverable from a single camera (research/05); qualitative bands only unless G1-b proves otherwise. Replaced an angle_vertical+transverse definition that was mathematically dead (constant 90 deg) — see L-011.
